$comment: Hand-maintained review layer over Scryfall Tagger (community tags on tagger.scryfall.com, read nightly from Scryfall's oracle_tags bulk by scripts/ingest/scryfall.ts; WAVE4 D3). Each flag pins its Tagger tag by UUID (slugs get renamed): a tag's cards are its taggings plus every descendant tag's. enabled: false is the kill-switch — the flag is written for no card and the bracket read says it couldn't check.

mld (mass-land-denial) splits the tag's list. clear = played as intended, the card takes away, locks or rewrites the mana of most lands of every opponent, whatever they play — Wizards' examples Armageddon, Ruination, Sunder, Winter Orb and Blood Moon, and cards that do the same (resets that take every land with them included); the read says at least Bracket 4. edge = the land denial hangs on something the list can't see: a planeswalker ultimate, a mode, one land type, snow or color, a number (X, threshold, storm, cards in hand or graveyard), a board where someone has fewer lands, random piles, or one land at a time from repeated triggers; the read asks 'Does it deny lands the way Armageddon does?'. A tagged card in neither list reads edge until someone reviews it (the run counts and logs it).

disabledCards: oracle id -> why; the flag is never written for that card. Keys are Scryfall oracle ids (card_identities.external_key, game 1); an id the run doesn't stage fails the run before any card is written — a typo must never half-apply. Reviewed against the 2026-10-01 bulk: mass-land-denial 113 taggings (111 of them our cards: 42 clear, 69 edge; the other two are an emblem and a Japanese-only card), extra-turn 64; neither tag has descendants.
